en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a hilltop complex dominated by a large rectangular building with a steep hipped roof and a domed tower. Below it are several long, elegant townhouses or institutional buildings flanking a tree‑lined path that leads toward a small monument or fountain in the foreground. The scene is surrounded by wooded hills. In the upper right corner is printed text reading "Frauenstein i. Erzgeb."
